Name: -OBSOLETE-Get Dressed
Author: jinxiewinxie
Description:
[size=5][b]WARNING!!:  This mod has been obsolete since the release of SDV 1.3!  Installing this mod will cause issues and not work properly on SDV 1.3 and SDV 1.4![/b][/size]


Adds a dresser with a mirror to the bedroom in each of the farmhouse upgrades. You can right click on the dresser to open up a Character Customization menu that let's you change your appearance. Additionally, about 110 new accessories have been added (they are mostly lipsticks and blushes).

[img]http://i.imgur.com/eCsHT4O.png[/img]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/9nlZzCH.png[/img]

[b]Information:[/b]

This is another mod brought to you by [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/501530/?]Advize[/url] and [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/8386684/?]Jinxiewinxie[/url]. It has been kept up to date by [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/members/pathoschild.704178/]Pathoschild[/url].

Requires [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/SMAPI/releases]SMAPI 1.15[/url] or later

It adds a dresser with a mirror to the bedroom in each of the farmhouse upgrades. You can right click on the dresser to open up a Character Customization menu that let's you change your appearance. Additionally, about 110 new accessories have been added (they are mostly lipsticks and blushes).

Download:[/b]
[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/331]Download Here[/url] on the Nexus (just click the file name or "download manually". Ensure you are using [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/SMAPI/releases]SMAPI 1.15 [/url] or later.
[b]

Installation Instructions:[/b]
[list]
[*]Download the mod
[/list]
[list]
[*]Extract the archive
[/list]
[list]
[*]Go to where your Stardew Valley game files are installed
[/list]
[list]
[*]Add the folder inside the Mods folder
[/list][b]

To use:[/b]
Just start your game using StardewModdingAPI.exe, and a config file will be created when you first load up the game. You can walk up to the dresser and right-click on it to open the Character Customization menu, or you can just press "C" on your keyboard by default. You can change which keybind to use to open the menu in the Config file.

You can also choose to hide the dresser completely by changing

"showDresser": true,

to be "showDresser": false,

If in the base farmhouse without any upgrades you're using another mod that let's you have a stove in the same corner where the dresser is meant to go, you can change

"stoveInCorner": false,

to be

"stoveInCorner": true,

and you'll see the dresser is moved a few tiles to the left so that you can have both the dresser and the stove.
[b]
